pages.text: Cows, sheep, goats, pigs, chickens and horses each have a $(thing)condition$(), from starving to top condition. It falls steadily, from top condition to starving in about two days without food.

Animals put on condition by $(thing)grazing$() grass (heavy grazing wears pasture down to bare soil), by eating from a $(thing)hay bale$() within two blocks (a bale feeds about ten meals), or when you feed them by hand: wheat, hay, oats, barley, maize, alfalfa or clover.
An $(thing)Alfalfa Hay Bale$() (nine alfalfa) is far richer than grass hay: each meal does half again as much good, and a bale lasts about fourteen meals.
Grass barely grows in cold weather, so in winter grazing gives little and animals need hay. Use $(thing)/tilth animal @n$() or Jade to see an animal's condition.
